review_method: Fresh labeled 16-pose sheet, native-size clockwise loop, and three independent unlabeled A/B comparisons.

directions.observed: Eyes and chin lifted toward screen-up.
directions.reason: Visible face below the raised brim; gaze lifted above the neutral eye line.
Eye pair and cheek shift right while the chin remains lifted.
The near eye moves right and up; head yaw is readable, but the adjacent 067.5 pose is similar.

directions.observed: Up-right with stronger right yaw, close to 045.
directions.reason: Asymmetric face width and eye position support rightward yaw; separation from 045 remains subtle.
Eyes and face are displaced right of the fixed laptop; near cheek and side hair show rightward yaw.
Lowered eye line and expanded visible hat crown accompany rightward face displacement.
Face sits under the forward brim with both eyes lowered and shifted right.
Lowered face under the broad brim; slight rightward eye and cheek offset from the straight-down pose.
Wide visible hat crown and low eye line; face and laptop stay centered.

directions.observed: Down with a small screen-left turn.
directions.reason: Low eyes and broad brim combine with a leftward face offset.

directions.observed: Down-left with compressed face under brim.
directions.reason: The eye pair and cheek sit left of the laptop center, under the down-tilted hat.

directions.observed: Screen-left with a small downward component.
directions.reason: Face shifts left; brow-to-brim spacing indicates a lower gaze than 270. The 225-to-247.5 head lift is a visibly larger step.
Eyes, nose and cheek are shifted left of the fixed torso/laptop; the hair clip remains on viewer-right.

directions.observed: Leftward head turn with lifted eyes.
directions.reason: Visible chin and higher eye line distinguish this from the horizontal-left pose.
Head and pupils shift left and upward; raised chin contrasts with down-left frames.
Lifted chin and eyes approach 000 while the leftward facial offset remains visible.
